task_title: 交固定 C 的 Contract Gate 相容性審查收據

baseline_evaluation.reasoning: Candidate C is the initial release to the dev target per RELEASE_MANIFEST.json (§initial_release_recovery) and EPHEMERAL_STAGING_PRODUCTION_ROLLOUT_PLAN.md (§8.5). No prior approved contract release or manifest exists for comparison. Comparing C against C is strictly forbidden, as is diffing against moving origin/dev. Backward compatibility against a nonexistent prior release cannot be claimed; Gate 1 remains fail-closed blocked.

evaluation_summary.summary_zh: 針對固定 candidate C 完成 Gate 1 (Contract Gate) 審查收據彙整與離線驗證。OpenAPI artifact、generated TypeScript client 及資料/產品契約 pin 經獨立隔離 scratch 驗證與程式碼吻合，但因 candidate C 屬於 initial release 缺乏已核准前版 baseline 且 ODP-PLAN-ENGINEERING-HARDENING-001 尚未 close，Gate 1 維持 blocked、release 維持 NO-GO。

gate_criteria_checks.name: OpenAPI diff reviewed for breaking changes and artifact freshness
required_checks: OpenAPI artifact matches live application schema
Generated TypeScript client matches OpenAPI artifact
Breaking changes detected and matched against approved breaking changes file
gate_criteria_checks.finding: Artifact and generated client are completely fresh and byte-stable against live app. Diff against an approved prior release cannot be executed because candidate C is an initial dev release.

gate_criteria_checks.name: Event schema compatibility checked
required_checks: Ingestion and domain intake state transitions conform to contract
gate_criteria_checks.finding: Event schemas under packages/schemas/ and intake state contracts pass unit/contract constraints in candidate C.

gate_criteria_checks.name: Data contract compatibility and pinning checked
required_checks: Data platform foundation client contract pin verified
Data platform product client contract pin verified
Data contract digest matches release manifest
gate_criteria_checks.finding: Data contract pin tests pass on C; foundation and product contracts resolve from vendored release bundles without direct coupling to producer storage DDL.

gate_criteria_checks.name: Model input/output compatibility checked
required_checks: Model parameter and prediction payload schemas validated
Decision simulation and scoring API request/response contracts conform
gate_criteria_checks.finding: Model interface payload schemas and pricing simulation writeback contracts pass in candidate C.

gate_criteria_checks.name: Breaking changes carry migration, compatibility window, and rollback plan
required_checks: Database migrations follow expand/contract pattern without destructive down migrations
Rollback and recovery plan documented and bound in manifest
gate_criteria_checks.finding: Candidate C utilizes initial release recovery (delete-candidate-zero-traffic) since dev has no prior release. Expand/contract pattern enforced; contract migration delayed to post-compatibility window.

checks_run: OpenAPI artifact freshness: matches live schema
Generated client freshness: matches OpenAPI artifact

open_blockers_and_downstream_responsibil.description: ODP-PLAN-ENGINEERING-HARDENING-001 is open and must close OpenAPI and frontend dependency hardening before formal Gate 1 attestation.
No prior approved release baseline exists on dev target; breaking change backward compatibility cannot be formally attested against a nonexistent version.
Candidate Gate 1 in RELEASE_GATE_REGISTRY.json must remain blocked with NO-GO decision preserved until formal admission prerequisites are cleared.
